platform.title: A cognitive AI platform for acoustic pianos
platform.intro: PyTune is not an app or a single-purpose tool. It is a scientific, real-time and collaborative platform designed to understand, measure and guide acoustic pianos — from absolute beginners to world-class professionals.

01.title: AI-Guided High-Precision Tuning
01.text: Audio-first tuning guidance driven by AI. Enables amateurs to tune without prior knowledge, while giving experts unmatched precision and control. Voice guidance — no need to look at the screen.

02.title: Professional Acoustic Diagnosis
02.text: Inharmonicity analysis, tuning curves and deviation maps based on real acoustic measurements — not approximations. Comparable, reproducible, and shareable.

04.title: Cognitive AI for Learning & Expertise
04.text: A knowledge platform to explore and deepen understanding of tuning, acoustics and piano behavior — contextual, explainable, and expert-grade.

05.title: Designed for Collaboration
05.text: Piano owners, technicians, restorers and manufacturers work within the same ecosystem — individual workflows and professional practice aligned.

06.title: Zero-Installation · Cross-Platform
06.text: No software to install. Works across phones, tablets, desktops and multi-screen setups. Piano dating and historical estimation included.

platform.signature: PyTune bridges amateurs and experts — from first tuning attempts to reference-level piano care.

what.title: What PyTune does for your piano

cards.title: Instant piano health check
cards.text: Take a few photos or play a short scale. PyTune analyzes tuning, condition, and key acoustic indicators using AI acoustics designed for real pianos — and tells you, in simple words, how your piano is doing.

cards.title: High-precision tuning view
cards.text: See where each note sits: clear tuning deviation charts, stability hints, and time-over tone. Under the hood, PyTune uses high-precision analysis similar to professional tools — but you don’t need to be a technician to read it.

cards.title: Clear, AI-guided explanations
cards.text: Your AI assistant explains what the graphs mean for you: “Can I keep playing?”, “Is it time to tune?”, “Is this normal for an older piano?” — all answered in everyday language, with options tailored to your situation.

cards.title: Your piano’s digital profile
cards.text: Photos, diagnostics, tuning history, reports, technician notes — everything stays in one place. Whether you keep the piano for life or sell it one day, PyTune builds a history that proves how well you’ve cared for it.

support.title: You’re not alone with your piano
support.subtitle: Use PyTune on your own, or share your results when you want human help. You stay in control: keep diagnostics private, or invite advanced users and professional tuners to look with you.

cards.title: Self-guided mode
cards.text: Run diagnostics whenever you like, get AI explanations, and decide when it’s time to call a technician — or simply enjoy playing with peace of mind.

cards.title: Share with a professional
cards.text: Send your diagnostic report to a tuner or teacher so they can prepare before visiting, give advice remotely, or follow your piano over time.

cards.title: Ask advanced users
cards.text: Connect with experienced users who love pianos as much as you do. Share specific measurements or screenshots and get friendly insight without giving up control over your piano.

steps.title: How it feels as a piano owner

items.title: Tell PyTune about your piano
items.text: Share what you know: brand, approximate age, or simply send a photo or talk to PyTune in your own words. The AI helps you identify and date your instrument so you know what you are working with.

items.title: Run your first diagnosis
items.text: Play a short sequence of notes or follow an on-screen guide. PyTune listens, measures, and builds a precise picture of your piano’s tuning, stability, and acoustic behaviour.

items.title: Understand the results with AI guidance
items.text: Instead of raw graphs only, you get a summary: how far out of tune your piano is, which areas are most affected, and what this means for daily playing, recording, or study — plus visual charts if you like digging deeper.

items.title: Decide your next step
items.text: Keep playing and monitor over time, book a tuning with confidence, or share your report with a technician or teacher. PyTune becomes your reference point for every decision about your piano.

craft.title: Your trade is tuning. Not prospecting.
craft.body: You know what an hour at the keyboard is worth. You also know the cost of a quiet week, a wasted trip, or a client who never calls back the following year. PyTune won’t teach you to tune a piano. It brings you pianos to tune, and helps you stop losing them.

step1.title: The owner measures their piano
step1.body: With their phone, for free. PyTune identifies the instrument from photos and analyses the tuning condition note by note.

step2.title: They choose to share their report
step2.body: Nothing is sent without their consent. When they want a professional to step in, they share their diagnosis.

step3.title: You receive a qualified request
step3.body: With the measurements, the identified instrument, the location and the contact details. You reply, and you travel knowing what to expect.

lead.title: What you know before you even pick up the phone
lead.subtitle: A contact form gives you a name and a number. A PyTune request gives you an instrument.

item1.label: The instrument
item1.value: Make, model, estimated year, serial number, type and dimensions

item2.label: Tuning condition
item2.value: Note-by-note deviation, actual pitch, most affected notes

item3.label: Acoustic signature
item3.value: Measured inharmonicity, partial structure, unison analysis

item5.label: Context
item5.value: Location, last known tuning date, owner’s observations

value.title: What it costs you, what it brings you
value.body: A tuning job bills between €90 and €150. Three extra clients in a year, and your subscription is paid back several times over.

guarantee.title: Our commitment
guarantee.body: If PyTune brings you no work in your first year, we refund you in full.

ai.title: A reasoned second opinion, on the instrument in front of you
ai.subtitle: A general AI knows piano technology. It doesn’t know your piano. PyTune’s has your measurements in front of it.
ai.body: It sees the identified instrument, its inharmonicity curve, the diagnosis you just ran and what was found on previous visits. Its answers are about this piano, not about pianos in general.

case1.title: The stubborn case
case1.body: A note that won’t hold, a unison that refuses to settle. Describe what you observe: the analysis accounts for your readings and past work on this instrument.

case2.title: The second opinion
case2.body: Before concluding hardened hammers or a damper issue, test your hypothesis. An opinion that contradicts you is worth more than one that agrees.

case3.title: The documentation, without the search
case3.body: Action specifications, model quirks, manufacturing practices. Ask during the job rather than reopening a manual that evening.

ai.footnote: The decision stays yours. The tool documents, argues and reminds — it replaces neither your ear nor your judgement.
